title: 3 Mining Metrics to Track Every Month
hook: Three metrics worth writing down every month.

scenes.narration: Your miner's power, measured in terahash per second. Note it each month.
Watts per terahash, where lower is more efficient. It decides your electricity per unit of hashrate.
Credited rewards minus maintenance, after discounts. This is the number that matters.

cta: What else do you track? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Hashrate, efficiency and net reward: three numbers for a monthly check.

sources.title: GoMining docs: maintenance fees and discounts
